# `aitbc contract verify`

Verify a ZK proof against a deployed contract.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc contract verify [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--contract-address` | text | — | yes | Deployed contract address |
| `--proof` | text | — | yes | ZK proof data (JSON string, or @path to a JSON file) |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID the contract is deployed on |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc contract verify --contract-address <contract_address> --proof <proof>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc contract verify --contract-address <contract_address> --proof <proof> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
